payload.message:
LQWDClaw Moltbook engagement cycle. Find a high-signal thread and comment.

STEP 1 — SCAN
Fetch Moltbook hot feed. Pick the highest-signal thread about Bitcoin, Lightning, LSPs, routing, liquidity, AI agents, or infrastructure. Score > 70 or skip.

STEP 2 — COMMENT
Write ONE concise technical comment. Follow SOUL.md. If LQWD is mentioned, append: "I'm affiliated with LQWD and LQWD AI."

STEP 3 — POST
Use curl with $MOLTBOOK_API_KEY. Solve math challenges automatically.

STEP 4 — LOG
Append to /opt/openclaw/workspace/engagement_log.md.

jobs.name: Telegram: Daily Moltbook Stats Report (09:00 PST)

payload.text: Reminder: It is 9 AM PST. As requested by the Operator, please fetch your current post and comment counts from the Moltbook API (and cross-reference local execution logs if necessary), and provide the daily running total update to the user in your normal persona voice.

Draft an X post for Boss's approval. KEEP IT FAST — one research source, one draft.

STEP 1 — QUICK RESEARCH (pick ONE source)
Check cache: python3 /opt/openclaw/workspace/skills/x_content_intel/update_cache.py --read-all

Pick the source most likely to yield a fresh angle:
- Option A: web_search for 1 query ("Lightning Network news" or "Bitcoin infrastructure")
- Option B: curl -s https://mempool.space/api/v1/fees/recommended | jq .
- Option C: Moltbook hot feed
- Option D: LQWD dashboard (max 1 in 4 posts — see SOUL.md distribution rule)

Do NOT hit multiple sources. One is enough.

STEP 2 — DRAFT X POST
HARD LIMIT: 260 characters max. Count before sending. Aim for 140-240.
Include one real data point. Be opinionated. Follow SOUL.md tone.

STEP 3 — SEND TO TELEGRAM
Format:

⚡ LQWDClaw X Post Draft
Topic: [topic]
Source: [source]
Draft: [tweet text]

Reply: APPROVE / REVISE / CANCEL

Wait for APPROVE before posting.

STEP 4 — IF APPROVED
1. Write to /opt/openclaw/workspace/x/draft.txt
2. bash /opt/openclaw/workspace/x/create_post_x.sh --from-file /opt/openclaw/workspace/x/draft.txt
3. Log to /opt/openclaw/workspace/x/x_post.log

payload.message:
Run the X Reply Monitoring cycle.

STEP 1 — COLLECT REPLIES
Check for replies to our recent tweets using:
cd /opt/openclaw/workspace/x && python3 fetch_replies.py

STEP 2 — FILTER
Evaluate against REPLY_DIRECTIVE.md rules. Discard memes, trolling, generic praise, bot replies.

STEP 3 — RESEARCH (if technical reply found)
If a reply contains a technical question about Lightning/Bitcoin infrastructure, do a quick web_search to find accurate data before drafting your response. Include specific facts in your reply.

STEP 4 — DRAFT RESPONSE
Write a reply (80-200 chars preferred, 280 max). Must add useful insight. Include data points from research if available.

STEP 5 — VALIDATION
Confirm compliance with SOUL.md and REPLY_DIRECTIVE.md rules.

STEP 6 — SEND FOR APPROVAL
Send Telegram message:

⚡ LQWDClaw Reply Proposal
Tweet: https://x.com/LQWDClaw/status/[tweet_id]
User: @[username]
Their Reply: [reply_text]
Proposed Response: [your_reply]

Reply: APPROVE / REVISE: [feedback] / CANCEL

STEP 7 — EXECUTION SUMMARY
YOU MUST RESPOND with: Status (Success/Failed), Execution Time (UTC), replies found count, action taken. If NO eligible replies found, state "No eligible replies found."

LQWDClaw — create and publish one original Moltbook post.

KEEP IT SIMPLE. Pick ONE research source, get ONE data point, write ONE post. Do not try to hit every API.

STEP 1 — PICK ONE RESEARCH SOURCE (rotate each cycle)
Check the cache first: python3 /opt/openclaw/workspace/skills/x_content_intel/update_cache.py --read-all

Then pick ONE source based on what is stale or interesting:
- Option A: web_search for Lightning/Bitcoin news (1 query only)
- Option B: curl -s https://mempool.space/api/v1/fees/recommended | jq . (mempool fees)
- Option C: Moltbook hot feed via API
- Option D: LQWD dashboard (see monitoring-dashboard skill) — max 1 in 4 posts

Do NOT hit all sources. One is enough.

STEP 2 — DRAFT
Write a Moltbook post with the data you found. Follow SOUL.md. Include one real data point. Be concise and opinionated.

STEP 3 — VALIDATE
No financial language, no fabricated facts, no negative LQWD language.

STEP 4 — PUBLISH
Post to Moltbook using curl with $MOLTBOOK_API_KEY. Solve math challenges automatically. No Telegram approval needed.

STEP 5 — LOG
Update cache: python3 /opt/openclaw/workspace/skills/x_content_intel/update_cache.py <section> '<json>'
Append to /opt/openclaw/workspace/moltbook_post_log.json
Update /opt/openclaw/workspace/moltbook_state.json

Rules: max once per 6h, no duplicate topics within 24h. Skip if no strong topic.

LQWDClaw — Daily Lightning implementation release check.

BEFORE STARTING: Read /opt/openclaw/workspace/RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md. Use the research cache at /opt/openclaw/workspace/research_cache.json — check github_releases cache (TTL 24h) before fetching. Update cache after every fetch.

STEP 1 — CHECK RELEASES (use cache if fresh)
Fetch latest releases from all major Lightning implementations:

curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/lightningnetwork/lnd/releases?per_page=3" | jq '[.[] | {repo: "LND", tag: .tag_name, date: .published_at, prerelease: .prerelease, body: .body[:500]}]'

curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/ElementsProject/lightning/releases?per_page=3" | jq '[.[] | {repo: "CLN", tag: .tag_name, date: .published_at, prerelease: .prerelease, body: .body[:500]}]'

curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/lightningdevkit/rust-lightning/releases?per_page=3" | jq '[.[] | {repo: "LDK", tag: .tag_name, date: .published_at, prerelease: .prerelease, body: .body[:500]}]'

curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/ACINQ/eclair/releases?per_page=3" | jq '[.[] | {repo: "Eclair", tag: .tag_name, date: .published_at, prerelease: .prerelease, body: .body[:500]}]'

STEP 2 — FILTER FOR NEW
Identify any releases published in the last 24 hours. If none, log "No new releases" and stop.

STEP 3 — ANALYZE
For each new release:
- Summarize the 3-5 most important changes relevant to routing, liquidity, LSP infrastructure, or security
- Note any breaking changes or deprecations
- Identify the LQWD relevance angle

STEP 4 — DRAFT MOLTBOOK POST
Write a Moltbook post about the release. Focus on infrastructure implications, not just changelog. Include specific version numbers and key changes.

STEP 5 — AUTO-PUBLISH TO MOLTBOOK
Post to Moltbook using curl with $MOLTBOOK_API_KEY. This is autonomous — no approval needed.

STEP 6 — DRAFT X POST
Write a 280-char max X post about the release. Include version number and one key change.

STEP 7 — SEND X DRAFT TO TELEGRAM
Send for operator approval:

⚡ LQWDClaw Release Alert

New Release: [repo] [version]
Key Change: [one-liner]

Draft X Post:
[tweet text]

Reply: APPROVE / REVISE / CANCEL

STEP 8 — LOG
Append to /opt/openclaw/workspace/engagement_log.md with releases checked, actions taken, posts created.
